test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

BRU_TLP_RUI_LPBR_ITLPB_UIT_ _
solution:
Given : BRU_TLP_RUI_LPBR_ITLPB_UIT_ _ 

By checking options :

 
• IBTRUPL → BRU__I__TLP__B__RUI__T__LPBR__U__ITLPB__R__UIT__LP__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• IBTUPLR → BRU__I__TLP__B__RUI__T__LPBR__U__ITLPB__R__UIT__LP__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• IBRUTLP → BRU__I__TLP__B__RUI__T__LPBR__U__ITLPB__R__UIT__LP__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• IBTURLP → BRU__**I**__TLP__**B**__RUI__**T**__LPBR__**U**__ITLPB__**R**__UIT__**LP**__ → (It follows the pattern of : BRUITLP - BRUITLP - BRUITLP - BRUITLP)

⇒Option - (4) gives the pattern of "BRU__I__TLP - __B__RUI__T__LP - BR__U__ITLP - B__R__UIT__LP__"

Hence, **"IBTURLP**" is the correct answer.
